The six reads cover the triage note, the hand-off, two new package specs and two engine specs (turns 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 9). The rest were only touched by searches (turns 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15).

The criteria say grep-only evidence is PARTIAL, not MET. The decision-record check also rests on a search for `Options|Chosen|chosen|Decision` that returned 227 characters (turn 14).
